import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
LH = 32


class LayerStem(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, Z, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = Z
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(8, hid, 1)
        self.glob_in = nn.Conv2d(3, hid, 1)
        self.zemb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, Z, hid, 1, 1))
        self.mid = nn.Conv2d(hid, hid, 1)

    def forward(self, obs):
        Z = self.Z
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bp = F.pad(b, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        tp = F.pad(t, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        per = torch.stack([b, bp[:, 0:Z], bp[:, 2:Z + 2], t, tp[:, 0:Z], tp[:, 2:Z + 2], m, e], dim=2)
        per = per.reshape(B * Z, 8, Y, X)
        h = self.inp(per).reshape(B, Z, -1, Y, X)
        g = self.glob_in(obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3]).unsqueeze(1)
        h = F.relu(h + g + self.zemb)
        h = F.relu(self.mid(h.reshape(B * Z, -1, Y, X))).reshape(B, Z, -1, Y, X)
        return torch.cat([h.mean(1), h.amax(1)], dim=1)


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.lstem = LayerStem(spec.Z, LH)
        self.dstem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.fuse = nn.Conv2d(STEM + 2 * LH, COL, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = F.relu(self.fuse(torch.cat([self.dstem(obs), self.lstem(obs)], dim=1)))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

H = 24
P = 16
HID = 24

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001}


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(8, H, 1)
        self.col = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, H, 1)
        self.zemb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, spec.Z, H, 1, 1))
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(H, H, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(H, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 2, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * spec.Z * H, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        Z = self.Z
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bdown = F.pad(b, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)
        bup = F.pad(b, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))
        tp = F.pad(t, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        per = torch.stack([b, bdown[:, 0:Z], bup[:, 1:Z + 1], t, tp[:, 0:Z], tp[:, 2:Z + 2], m, e], dim=2)
        h = self.inp(per.reshape(B * Z, 8, Y, X)).reshape(B, Z, H, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.col(obs).unsqueeze(1) + self.zemb)
        h = h.reshape(B * Z, H, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.conv(h))
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            o = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))).reshape(B, Z, 2, Y, X)
            w = torch.softmax(o[:, :, 1], dim=1)
            res.append((w * o[:, :, 0]).sum(1).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        hv = h.reshape(B, Z, H, Y, X)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([hv.mean((3, 4)).flatten(1), hv.amax((3, 4)).flatten(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001}


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=2, dilation=2)
        self.gctx = nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c3(f))
        pooled = torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        f2 = F.relu(f + self.gctx(pooled).unsqueeze(2).unsqueeze(3))
        place = self.head(f2)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no results yet, and scores stay hidden all search, so later rounds learn only from crashes and check failures. The final pick takes the best 2-seed score, so the job is to spread the 12 trials over good but different candidates. Two observations shape round 1. First, the default recipe gets only 32 updates (131,072 steps / 4,096 per update), so smaller rollouts with fewer epochs may help a lot. Second, a correct placement depends on each column: the landing layer is the highest built cell under the brick, and the target must be filled at that layer. A stem that processes every layer with shared weights and sees the layers just above and below gives the network a reusable way to compare build and target at the surface. Round 1 tests the recipe alone, the layer stem alone, and both together.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials trained without errors, but scores are hidden, so nothing yet tells us whether more updates or a layer-aware stem helped. Without scores, the best guide is the structure of the task. A placement is right when the brick lands at layer z (the cells under its footprint are occupied at z-1 and empty at z), every footprint cell at z is missing from the build, and no missing target cell below gets sealed. The starting trunk squashes the layers into 2D features, so it must learn this landing check indirectly. This round tests three things: (1) a head that scores each placement per layer and lets the network learn which layer is the landing layer; (2) the trade between PPO epochs and samples, keeping the network fixed; (3) a deeper trunk with global context fed back into the placement head. Comparing these to round 1 should show whether the network or the recipe matters more.
analyses.3: Every trial so far trained without errors, but scores are hidden, so nothing has been ranked. I have to choose using knowledge of the task and keep the candidates varied. An exact build needs each brick to land at the right layer: the highest point under its footprint must equal the target layer, every footprint cell must be missing at that layer, and nothing it covers should still be needed below. A head that pools over footprints separately at each layer (r2c1) fits this best. But r2c1 had no spatial context beyond its own 3x3 conv, while the 2D trunks (baseline, r2c3) lack per-layer resolution. So this round: (1) combine the 2D trunk's context with r2c1's per-layer gated footprint head; (2) r2c1 with the more-data recipe (2 epochs, longer rollouts, higher gamma and lambda) to separate recipe from architecture; (3) a new idea: whole-grid self-attention on the baseline trunk, using r2c2's recipe so it compares directly with r2c2. Each extra network stays at or below about 1.4x the starting compute.
